posts.name: Paul
posts.cooked:
This month's update will be pretty short because of how chaotic and awful everything is at GTG HQ right now. Here's a look at some of the things we did in the past month:

  • We worked through project management planning for the SCRPG, Spirit Island KS, Homebrewers, and a bunch of other stuff.
  • The warehouse received and shipped so much stuff that I'm surprised Jodie and Matt are still alive.
  • Christopher, Adam, and I signed a billion things because our past selves are jerks.
  • We made lots of plans to hopefully one day have a larger warehouse.

Here is the status of all of our works in progress.

In Stock Since August

Nothing

Shipping to Backers

  1. The OblivAeon stuff for European fulfillment
  2. SotM: OblivAeon
  3. SotM: Stuntman, Benchmark, & Void Guard
  4. SotM: Complete Hero Variant Collection
  5. SotM: Ultimate Collector's Case
  6. SotM: 5th Anniversary Foil Villain Collection
  7. SotM: Promo Cards
  8. The giant OblivAeon KS shipping cartons.

In Transit; On A Train

  1.  More OblivAeon Stuff
  2. Spirit Island (even even more)
  3. Spirit Island: Branch & Claw reprint
  4. Spirit Island: Promo Spirit Pack reprint
  5. Compounded reprint
  6. Bottom of the 9th mini-expansion reprint

At Factory; Pre-Press Work

  1. Legend of Sleepy Hollow

Current WIP Focus by GTG

  1. Sentinel Comics: The Role Playing Game core rulebook (Christopher, Jenn, Critical Hits)
  2. Prime War (Christopher, Chris Burton, Lore Forge)
  3. Spirit Island: The Jagged Earth (Paul, Christopher, Jenn, Erik)
  4. Sentinels of Freedom video game (Christopher, Adam, Underbite Studio)
  5. The History of Sentinel Comics (Christopher, Adam)
  6. Fate of the Elder Gods: Agents of Arkham (Chris Kirkman)
  7. Homebrewers (Chris Kirkman, Chris Burton, SaRae)
  8. Some other games (Chris Kirkman, Chris Burton)
  9. A new and improved website (Jenn, Paul, Alex, Joel)

I'll see you next month!
